llm.summary: This skill is a local-only note and document board with no network behavior, though users should understand that it stores pasted content and uploaded files in browser storage.

dimensions.detail: The application uses browser APIs for clipboard paste/copy, file selection, drag-and-drop, downloads, localStorage, and IndexedDB, which are proportionate to the disclosed local note/image/file management purpose.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a static HTML file with no dependencies or installer; the only packaging command is a user-directed skill packaging step.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Most trigger language is aligned with text collection and document export, but the line about packaging arbitrary HTML as a skill is broader than the core note-board purpose.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Content, images, and uploaded file blobs persist locally in browser storage; deletion controls are user-directed, but users should be aware that browser storage may retain data until explicitly cleared.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is a single-file front-end note board for collecting text, managing images/files, and exporting Word documents; the inspected HTML implements those capabilities without unrelated functions.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you want a browser-local note board that stores pasted text, images, and selected files on the device. Avoid putting highly sensitive material into it unless you are comfortable managing browser localStorage and IndexedDB cleanup yourself.
llm.findings: [SQP-1] unexpected: The broad packaging trigger is wider than the core note-board purpose, but it affects invocation scope rather than adding hidden privileges, network access, automatic execution, or unrelated data handling.
